rules.sentence: on a pyarrow series [1, 2, 3], scatter(1, 999) returns [1, 999, 3].
on a pyarrow series [1, 2, 3], scatter([0, 2], [999, 888]) returns [999, 2, 888].
for any pyarrow series and any distinct in-range indices with as many values, scatter puts each value at its index and leaves every other position unchanged.
on a pyarrow series [1, 2, 3], scatter(2, 7) returns [1, 2, 7].

rules.sentence: on a pyarrow series [1, 2, 3], scatter(-1, 999) raises an out-of-bounds error.
on a pyarrow series [1, 2, 3], scatter(3, 999) raises an out-of-bounds error.
on a pyarrow series [1, 2, 3], scatter([0, 2, 1], [7, 8, 9]) returns [7, 9, 8].
on a pyarrow series [1, 2, 3], scatter(0, 999) returns [999, 2, 3].
scatter leaves the original pyarrow series unchanged and returns a series of the same kind.
scattering a pyarrow series [142, 124, 132] into itself at [0, 2, 1] returns [142, 132, 124].
